method: editor + terminal window with real source and real captured output (option 3); no third-party site contacted
notes: The repo (WiseBuy/research, private, one commit, April 2023) is three research scripts with no CLI, no tests and no fixtures: ScrapingProductsWithRating.py, product_price_comparison.py and product_reviews_amazon.py (review scraper + TextBlob sentiment + pandas processing). All of them request a shopping site as soon as they are run, so none was run as-is. The image is an editor pane over a terminal pane. Editor: lines 141-162 of product_reviews_amazon.py, verbatim with real line numbers (the review-parsing loop inside get_product_reviews_amazon, including the author's own Arabic comment). Terminal: captured in a copy (run/wisebuy, Python 3.9 venv with the repo's pinned beautifulsoup4/requests/textblob/pandas): the two function definitions and their imports were cut out of the file unchanged with sed (lines 115-119, 125-169, 198-217 -> offline.py, leaving out the module-level calls that hit the live site), then the repo's own get_product_reviews_amazon() and reviews_data_processing() were called on a LOCAL sample page served from 127.0.0.1:8136. The printed table (200 status line, title/stars/sentiment/word_count/positive_review) is exactly what those functions returned. Commands in fl/wisebuy/session.sh, raw capture in session.out. SAMPLE INPUT, please note: the page they parsed (fl/wisebuy/sample-reviews.html) was written by me for this run - five generic review texts for an unnamed product, marked up with the CSS class names the code searches for; it is not scraped data and not real customers. The sentiment and word-count numbers are really computed by the repo's code from that sample text; the 'positive_review' column is the code's own cumulative-threshold rule, shown as it came out. Doubts: the result therefore demonstrates the parsing/analysis code, not a live price comparison; product_price_comparison.py's comparison branch is commented out in the repo and Laptops.csv is empty, so nothing was taken from them. Window title and tab label are chrome I wrote.
